versions.content: The function Fr_ReconfigLPdu shall perform the following tasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx: 1. Figure out the physical resource (e.g., a buffer) mapped to the processing of the FlexRay frame as identified by Fr_LpduIdx. 2. Configure the physical resource (a buffer) according to the parameters given at the API. The Lpdu direction is statically associated with the Lpdu and cannot be changed by this service. 3. Return E_OK.
